import org.junit.runner.JUnitCore
import kotlin.system.exitProcess

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val policy = Class.forName("kotlinx.coroutines.DebugKt")
    fun flag(name: String) = policy.getMethod(name).invoke(null) as Boolean
    val assertions = flag("getASSERTIONS_ENABLED")
    val debug = flag("getDEBUG")
    val recovery = flag("getRECOVER_STACK_TRACES")
    check(assertions && debug && recovery)
    check(System.getProperty("kotlinx.coroutines.stacktrace.recovery") == null)
    check(System.getProperty("kotlinx.coroutines.debug") == null)
    println("VW_POLICY assertions=$assertions debug=$debug recovery=$recovery; no coroutine property overrides")
    val result = JUnitCore.runClasses(*args.map { Class.forName(it) }.toTypedArray())
    result.failures.forEach { println(it.trace) }
    println("VW_RESULT tests=${result.runCount} failures=${result.failureCount} ignored=${result.ignoreCount}")
    exitProcess(if (result.wasSuccessful()) 0 else 1)
}
